SELECT_FOLDER_TO_START_ANALYSIS: Select a folder to start the analysis.
TELEMETRY_STORAGE_DESCRIPTION: CSV files located in this directory are automatically parsed and displayed on your Overview dashboard. Direct USB sync copies completed sessions from your connected phone into this destination.
GPS_UNAVAILABLE_SESSIONS_NOTICE: GPS information has not been recorded for these sessions, or the coordinate pairs are invalid. Your telemetry charts remain available.
IMPORT_TELEMETRY_DESCRIPTION: Import telemetry CSV files to explore performance, battery and temperature data.
SELECT_DONATION_PLATFORM: Select a donation platform to support ongoing development and maintenance.
RIDE_MAP_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTION: Ride map. Drag to pan, use plus and minus to zoom, or use arrow keys.
SAMPLE_VALUES_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTION: Telemetry values for the inspected sample
CHOOSE_SAMPLE_INSTRUCTION: Choose a sample on the route or with the slider.
MAP_BACKGROUND_DESCRIPTION: Map background uses OpenStreetMap online tiles.
HOVER_BLUE_ROUTE_INSTRUCTION: Hover the blue route to inspect a sample.
CHOOSE_IMPORT_SOURCE_INSTRUCTION: Choose a folder on this computer or sync completed sessions from your phone.
INSPECT_ASSIST_LEVEL_INSTRUCTION: Hover a level to inspect its first sample; use the sample slider to explore the ride.
BATTERY_PROVENANCE_NOTICE: Based on reported charge levels, not measured energy. Unrecorded consumption is not included.
NO_SESSIONS_MATCH_FILTER: No telemetry sessions match the selected filter.
FOLDER_READY_FOR_SYNC: Folder ready. Sync your phone to add completed sessions.
CHOOSE_FOLDER_TO_ENABLE_SYNC: Choose a CSV folder above to enable phone sync.
SYNC_NEEDS_ATTENTION: Sync finished with items needing attention
SYNC_FILES_READY_NOTICE: Completed files are ready for analysis. No files were deleted.
SELECT_CONNECTED_PHONE_INSTRUCTION: Select a connected phone. Unlock it and choose File transfer if it is not listed.
PHONE_DETECTED_INSTRUCTION: Phone detected. Start sync to check storage and import completed sessions.
NO_PHONE_DETECTED_INSTRUCTION: No phone detected. Connect a data-capable USB cable, unlock the phone and select File transfer.
PHONE_SYNC_WINDOWS_ONLY: Phone sync is available on Windows.
DIRECT_USB_SYNC_WINDOWS_ONLY: Direct USB sync is available on Windows.
GPS_UNAVAILABLE_SELECTION_NOTICE: GPS information was not recorded for this selection, or no valid coordinate pairs are available.
GPS_STRAIGHT_CONNECTION_NOTICE: Straight connections between fixes do not identify the exact trail.
INSPECT_CHART_OR_ROUTE_INSTRUCTION: Hover a chart or the blue route to inspect a sample. Use the slider for overlapping GPS fixes.
MAP_BACKGROUND_UNAVAILABLE_NOTICE: Map background unavailable or incomplete. The GPS route and sample inspection still work.
MAP_ONLINE_PRIVACY_NOTICE: Online tiles: OpenStreetMap receives your IP and the viewed map area. GPS samples stay local.
MAP_BACKGROUND_OFF_NOTICE: Online background off. The GPS route and sample inspection work locally.
GPS_POSITION_ESTIMATED_NOTICE: GPS position estimated across a short gap.
GPS_POSITION_UNAVAILABLE_NOTICE: GPS position unavailable for this sample.
FULL_SCREEN_UNAVAILABLE: Full screen is unavailable in this window.
SYNC_DESTINATION_CHANGE_BLOCKED: Wait for the current sync or cancel it before changing the destination.
SELECTED_PHONE_DISCONNECTED: The selected phone is no longer connected.
SAVED_TELEMETRY_PATH_NOT_FOLDER: The saved telemetry path is not a folder.
CSV_EXCEEDS_MANIFEST_SIZE: CSV is larger than its completion manifest.
CSV_INTEGRITY_FAILED_NOTICE: CSV integrity verification failed. The incomplete copy has been retained.
PHONE_DISCONNECTED_WINDOWS_INSTRUCTION: The selected phone is no longer connected to Windows. Check the USB cable, unlock the phone, and select File transfer / Android Auto.
DUPLICATE_MANIFEST_FILENAME: Duplicate manifest filename on the phone.
DUPLICATE_SESSION_IDENTITY: Duplicate session identity on the phone.
SYNC_STAGING_REQUIRES_DIRECTORY: The sync staging folder must be a real directory.
DIRECT_PHONE_SYNC_WINDOWS_INSTRUCTION: Direct phone sync currently requires Windows. You can still select a folder of CSV files on this computer.
TOO_MANY_FOLDER_OBJECTS: Too many objects in this folder
PHONE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE_INSTRUCTION: Phone storage is unavailable. Unlock the phone and select File transfer.
PHONE_PTP_MODE_INSTRUCTION: The phone is using Photo transfer (PTP), which exposes only photos. On the phone choose USB mode File transfer / Android Auto, keep it unlocked, and wait for Internal storage to appear in Windows. Then run Sync again.
BATTERY_CHARGE_TIME_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRI: Battery charge percentage over elapsed session time
BATTERY_PERCENTAGE_POINTS_NOTICE: pp = percentage points; totals can exceed 100. Charging between sessions does not affect the sum.
BATTERY_EXCLUDED_CHARGE_INCREASE: {exclusion} charge increased within the session (possible charging or gauge recovery).
BATTERY_EXCLUDED_INVALID_READINGS: {exclusion} missing, invalid or insufficient battery readings.
BATTERY_DISCHARGE_REQUIREMENTS: Discharge chart requires at least {minimum} pp of drop, valid timestamps and no charge increases.
PHONE_SYNC_SETUP_INSTRUCTION: Connect and unlock your phone, then select {transferMode}. Completed sessions are added to the CSV folder selected above. If Windows shows only {dcim} and {pictures}, the phone is in Photo transfer (PTP) mode and telemetry files cannot be exposed.
SYNC_CANCELLING_NOTICE: Cancelling… Completed copies will be preserved.
GPS_SESSIONS_WITHOUT_COORDINATES: {missing} of {total} sessions have no recorded valid GPS coordinates (including older CSV files).
GPS_BRIDGED_GAPS_SUMMARY: {count} short gaps bridged with {positions} estimated positions.
GPS_DISCONNECTED_GAPS_SUMMARY: {count} longer gaps or implausible jumps left disconnected.
OPEN_IMPORT_DATA_INSTRUCTION: Open {importData} to choose a folder or sync your phone.
TELEMETRY_FOLDER_DIALOG_TITLE: Where should telemetry CSV files be stored on this computer?
TELEMETRY_FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE: The telemetry folder is no longer available: {folder}
FILE_CONTENT_CONFLICT: Conflict: {name} already exists with different content.
FILE_ADD_UNSAFE_NOTICE: Cannot safely add this file ({code}). Choose a local folder that supports hard links, such as NTFS.
DESTINATION_CONTENT_CHANGED: {name}: the destination appeared with different content during the copy.
SYNC_CANCELLED_NOTICE: Sync cancelled. Completed copies are preserved.
PHONE_STOPPED_RESPONDING: The phone stopped responding. Check the USB connection.
USB_COPY_INTERRUPTED: USB copy interrupted. Check the phone connection.
PHONE_TELEMETRY_FOLDER_NOT_FOUND: Download/ApexDrive/Telemetry was not found. Finish a ride and open ApexDrive to publish saved sessions. Visible phone storage: {storage}
SYNC_RETAINED_BYTES_NOTICE: {size} retained for recovery. No files were deleted.
EXAMPLE_TELEMETRY_DESCRIPTION: Explore the included ride without choosing a folder. Example data is kept separate from your sessions.
EXAMPLE_TELEMETRY_NOTICE: You are viewing the example ride. It is excluded from your personal session totals.
